    COUNT(*) AS Capacity
FROM 
    course AS C
INNER JOIN 
    course_arrange AS CA ON C.Course_ID = CA.Course_ID
INNER JOIN 
    teacher AS T ON CA.Teacher_ID = T.Teacher_ID
WHERE 
    CAST(strftime('%Y', C.Staring_Date) AS INTEGER) > 2013
GROUP BY 
    T.Hometown
ORDER BY 
    Capacity DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    Course AS Stadium_Name, 
    COUNT(*) AS Capacity
FROM 
    course
WHERE 
    Staring_Date > '2013-12-31'
GROUP BY 
    Course
ORDER BY 
    Capacity DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT Course, COUNT(*) AS Concert_Count
FROM course

ORDER BY Concert_Count DESC

    s.Capacity
FROM 
    concert c

    stadium s

    s.Stadium_ID

    COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    stadium.Name, 
    stadium.Capacity
FROM 
    course
JOIN 
    course_arrange ON course.Course_ID = course_arrange.Course_ID

SELECT 
    stadium.Name, 
    stadium.Capacity
FROM 
    stadium
JOIN 
    concerts ON stadium.Stadium_ID = concerts.Stadium_ID
JOIN 
    course ON concerts.Course_ID = course.Course_ID
WHERE 
    course.Staring_Date > '2013-01-01'
GROUP BY 
    stadium.Stadium_ID
ORDER BY 
    COUNT(concerts.Concert_ID) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    s.Stadium_Name, 
    s.Capacity
FROM 
    stadium s
JOIN 
    concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID

    course cr ON c.Course_ID = cr.Course_ID

    s.Stadium_Name, s.Capacity

WITH stadium_capacity AS (
    SELECT
        T3.Hometown,
        COUNT(DISTINCT T1.Course_ID) AS Num_Courses
    FROM
        course AS T1
    INNER JOIN
        course_arrange AS T2 ON T1.Course_ID = T2.Course_ID
    INNER JOIN
        teacher AS T3 ON T2.Teacher_ID = T3.Teacher_ID
    GROUP BY
        T3.Hometown
),
max_capacity AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(Num_Courses) AS Max_Courses
    FROM
        stadium_capacity
)
SELECT
    T1.Num_Courses
FROM
    stadium_capacity AS T1
WHERE
    T1.Num_Courses = (SELECT Max_Courses FROM max_capacity)

    SELECT
        student_id,
        COUNT(*) AS ticket_count
    FROM
        Friend
    GROUP BY
        student_id

MembershipLevels AS (
    SELECT
        T1.student_id,
        T2.name,
        CASE
            WHEN T1.ticket_count BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 'Bronze'
            WHEN T1.ticket_count BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN 'Silver'
            ELSE 'Gold'
        END AS membership_level
    FROM
        TicketCounts T1
    LEFT JOIN
        Highschooler T2
    ON
        T1.student_id = T2.ID

    SELECT 
        student_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_tickets

        total_tickets,
        CASE 
            WHEN total_tickets >= 20 THEN 'Gold'

        END AS membership_level

    continents con ON c.Continent = con.ContId

INNER JOIN commanders c ON b.Commander = c.Id
WHERE b.BattleField = 'English Channel' 
  AND b.ShipsLost = 0 
  AND c.Country = 'Bulgaria'

SELECT 
    b.battle_name,
    b.result,
    c.country_name AS commander_country
FROM 
    battles b
JOIN 
    battle_participation bp ON b.battle_id = bp.battle_id
JOIN 
    countries c ON bp.country_id = c.country_id
JOIN 
    ships s ON bp.battle_id = s.battle_id
WHERE 
    b.location = 'English Channel'
    AND s.lost = 0
    AND c.country_name = 'Bulgaria'
GROUP BY 
    b.battle_name, b.result, c.country_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.ship_name) = 0;  -- Ensures no ships were lost

SELECT b.name, b.result, c.commander_name
FROM battles b
JOIN battle_commanders bc ON b.id = bc.battle_id
JOIN commanders c ON bc.commander_id = c.id
WHERE b.location = 'English Channel'
  AND b.ships_lost = 0
  AND c.nationality = 'Bulgarian'

    FROM VOTES v

    GROUP BY week_year, c.contestant_name
),
Ranking AS (
    SELECT

        PARTITION BY strftime('%Y-%W', V.created)
        ORDER BY COUNT(V.phone_number) DESC
    ) AS weekly_rank
FROM 
    VOTES AS V
INNER JOIN 
    CONTESTANTS AS C

    V.contestant_number = C.contestant_number

    SELECT

    FROM

    LEFT JOIN

    SELECT 
        property_id, 
        property_name, 
        agreed_selling_price
    FROM

    ORDER BY

    LIMIT 1

WITH PokerPlayers AS (
    SELECT
        p.property_id,
        p.property_name,
        of.feature_id,
        oaf.feature_name,
        oaf.feature_description
    FROM
        Properties p
    INNER JOIN
        Other_Property_Features of ON p.property_id = of.property_id
    INNER JOIN
        Other_Available_Features oaf ON of.feature_id = oaf.feature_id
),
HeightRank AS (
    SELECT
        pp.property_name,
        pp.feature_name,
        pp.feature_description,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(pp.feature_description AS INTEGER) DESC) AS height_rank
    FROM
        PokerPlayers pp
    WHERE
        pp.feature_name = 'Height'
),
MoneyRank AS (
    SELECT
        pp.property_name,
        pp.feature_name,
        pp.feature_description,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(pp.feature_description AS INTEGER) DESC) AS money_rank
    FROM
        PokerPlayers pp
    WHERE
        pp.feature_name = 'Money'
)
SELECT
    mr.money_rank
FROM
    HeightRank hr
JOIN
    MoneyRank mr ON hr.property_name = mr.property_name
WHERE
    hr.height_rank = 1

WITH PlayerContinent AS (
    SELECT player_id, country_code,
           CASE 
               WHEN country_code IN ('US', 'CA') THEN 'North America'
               WHEN country_code IN ('GB', 'FR', 'DE', 'ES') THEN 'Europe'
               WHEN country_code IN ('AU', 'NZ') THEN 'Oceania'
               WHEN country_code IN ('JP', 'CN', 'IN') THEN 'Asia'
               WHEN country_code IN ('BR') THEN 'South America'
               ELSE 'Unknown'
           END AS continent
    FROM players
),
MatchContinent AS (
    SELECT m.match_num, 
           pc1.continent AS winner_continent,
           pc2.continent AS loser_continent
    FROM matches m
    JOIN PlayerContinent pc1 ON m.winner_id = pc1.player_id
    JOIN PlayerContinent pc2 ON m.loser_id = pc2.player_id
),
ContinentLanguageDiversity AS (
    SELECT winner_continent AS continent, COUNT(DISTINCT m.winner_id) AS language_count
    FROM MatchContinent m
    GROUP BY winner_continent
    UNION ALL
    SELECT loser_continent AS continent, COUNT(DISTINCT m.loser_id) AS language_count
    FROM MatchContinent m
    GROUP BY loser_continent
)
SELECT continent, SUM(language_count) AS total_language_count
FROM ContinentLanguageDiversity
GROUP BY continent
ORDER BY total_language_count DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH AsianPlayers AS (
    SELECT 
        hand,
        COUNT(*) AS player_count
    FROM players
    WHERE country_code IN ('SUI', 'CRO', 'BEL') -- Assuming these are Asian country codes
    GROUP BY hand
),
TotalPlayers AS (
    SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total_player_count
    FROM AsianPlayers
)
SELECT 
    hand AS language,
    player_count AS number_of_players
FROM AsianPlayers
JOIN TotalPlayers ON AsianPlayers.player_count = TotalPlayers.total_player_count
ORDER BY player_count DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH language_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    language,
    COUNT(*) AS player_count
  FROM 
    players p
  JOIN 
    country_languages cl ON p.country_code = cl.country_code
  WHERE 
    p.country_code IN ('IND', 'CHN', 'JPN', 'KOR', 'THA', 'VNM', 'MYS', 'SGP', 'BRA', 'NZL', 'AUS', 'CA', 'GB')
  GROUP BY 
    language
)
SELECT 
  language
FROM 
  language_counts
WHERE 
  player_count = (SELECT MAX(player_count) FROM language_counts)
LIMIT 1

WITH AsianPlayers AS (
    SELECT country_code
    FROM players
    WHERE country_code IN ('CNO', 'KOR', 'JPN')  -- Hypothetical Asian country codes
),
LanguageMap AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN country_code = 'CNO' THEN 'Chinese'
            WHEN country_code = 'KOR' THEN 'Korean'
            WHEN country_code = 'JPN' THEN 'Japanese'
            ELSE 'Unknown'
        END AS language
    FROM AsianPlayers
),
LanguageCount AS (
    SELECT language, COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM LanguageMap
    GROUP BY language
),
MostUsedLanguage AS (
    SELECT language
    FROM LanguageCount
    ORDER BY count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT language AS 'Most Used Language'
FROM MostUsedLanguage

SELECT

        - (strftime('%m-%d', m.tourney_date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.birth_date))) AS average_age
FROM 
    players p
JOIN 
    matches m ON p.player_id = m.winner_id OR p.player_id = m.loser_id
JOIN 
    countries c ON p.country_code = c.country_code
WHERE 
    c.official_language != 'English'

SELECT AVG(le.life_expectancy) AS average_life_expectancy
FROM players p
INNER JOIN languages l ON p.country_code = l.country_code
INNER JOIN life_expectancy le ON p.country_code = le.country_code
WHERE l.language != 'English'

WITH official_english_countries AS (
    SELECT 'USA' AS country_code UNION ALL
    SELECT 'GBR' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CAN' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'AUS' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'NZL' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'IND' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'SGB' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'IEN' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'KEN' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'ZAF'
),
filtered_countries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.country_code
    FROM players p
    LEFT JOIN official_english_countries oec ON p.country_code = oec.country_code
    WHERE oec.country_code IS NULL
),
life_expectancy_data AS (
    SELECT 
        le.country_code, 
        le.life_expectancy
    FROM 
        filtered_countries fc
    JOIN 
        life_expectancy le ON fc.country_code = le.country_code
)
SELECT 
    AVG(life_expectancy) AS avg_life_expectancy
FROM 
    life_expectancy_data

WITH PlayerLifeExpectancy AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS age
    FROM
        players
)
SELECT
    AVG(age) AS avg_age
FROM
    PlayerLifeExpectancy
WHERE
    player_id IN (
        SELECT
            winner_id
        FROM
            matches
    )
    OR
    player_id IN (
        SELECT
            loser_id
        FROM
            matches
    )

WITH PlayerAges AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_id,
        p.first_name,
        p.last_name,
        p.country_code,
        strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.birth_date) AS age
    FROM
        players p
),
CountryAverages AS (
    SELECT
        pa.country_code,
        AVG(pa.age) AS average_age
    FROM
        PlayerAges pa
    GROUP BY
        pa.country_code

NonEnglishCountries AS (
    SELECT
        DISTINCT lc.iso_code

    CountryAverages ca

    NonEnglishCountries nec ON ca.country_code = nec.iso_code

        m.winner_id = p.player_id OR m.loser_id = p.player_id

WHERE p.country_code IN (
    SELECT country_code
    FROM players
    WHERE country_code LIKE 'AF%'
)
GROUP BY p.country_code
HAVING COUNT(p.player_id) < (
    SELECT MIN(asia_player_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(player_id) AS asia_player_count
        FROM players
        WHERE country_code LIKE 'AS%'
        GROUP BY country_code
    ) AS asia_counts
)

SELECT country_code, COUNT(*) AS player_count

    SELECT MIN(player_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
        FROM players
        WHERE country_code IN ('ASI1', 'ASI2', 'ASI3')
        GROUP BY country_code
    )
)

WITH PlayerCountByCountry AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code,

    FROM players

),
ContinentPlayerCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code,
        player_count,
        CASE 
            WHEN country_code IN ('AO', 'EG', 'MA', 'DZ', 'NG', 'SN', 'TD', 'CM', 'GA', 'CI', 'CD', 'LR', 'ML', 'NE', 'TG', 'BF', 'BJ', 'GN', 'MR', 'SD', 'SL', 'TG', 'GQ', 'ST', 'AO', 'ET', 'ER', 'SC', 'RW', 'KE', 'TZ', 'UG', 'BI', 'MU', 'ZM', 'MW', 'MZ', 'LS', 'NA', 'BW', 'SW', 'ZM', 'ZW', 'ZA', 'LS', 'BW', 'ZW', 'UG', 'NA', 'LS', 'BW', 'RW', 'KE', 'TZ', 'ZM', 'MW', 'MZ', 'LS', 'NA', 'BW') THEN 'Africa'

            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS continent
    FROM PlayerCountByCountry

    FROM

WITH PopulationPerDistrict AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN winner_ioc IS NOT NULL THEN winner_ioc 
            ELSE loser_ioc 
        END AS district,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
            WHEN winner_ioc IS NOT NULL THEN winner_id 
            ELSE loser_id 
        END) AS city_count
    FROM matches
    GROUP BY district
),
AveragePopulation AS (
    SELECT AVG(city_count) AS avg_city_count
    FROM PopulationPerDistrict
)

    p.district, 
    COUNT(p.city_count) AS num_cities_with_more_than_avg_population
FROM

GROUP BY

WITH SpanishSpeakers AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code,
        COUNT(*) AS total_players
    FROM 
        players
    WHERE 
        country_code IN (SELECT country_code FROM players WHERE first_name LIKE '%Spanish%' OR last_name LIKE '%Spanish%')
    GROUP BY 
        country_code
),
TotalPlayers AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code,
        COUNT(*) AS total_players
    FROM 
        players
    GROUP BY 
        country_code
),
SpanishPercentage AS (
    SELECT 
        s.country_code,
        s.total_players,
        t.total_players AS total_country_players,
        (s.total_players * 1.0 / t.total_players) * 100 AS percentage_spanish_speakers
    FROM 
        SpanishSpeakers s
    JOIN 
        TotalPlayers t ON s.country_code = t.country_code
),
RankedCountries AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code,
        percentage_spanish_speakers,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY percentage_spanish_speakers DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        SpanishPercentage
)
SELECT 
    country_code
FROM 
    RankedCountries
WHERE 
    rank = 1

    GROUP BY

)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT other_conductors.Conductor_ID) AS Friend_Count
FROM conductor kyle
JOIN orchestra kyle_orchestras ON kyle.Conductor_ID = kyle_orchestras.Conductor_ID
JOIN orchestra other_orchestras ON kyle_orchestras.Orchestra = other_orchestras.Orchestra
JOIN conductor other_conductors ON other_orchestras.Conductor_ID = other_conductors.Conductor_ID
WHERE kyle.Name = 'Kyle'
  AND other_conductors.Name != 'Kyle'

WITH Kyle_Conductor AS (
    SELECT Conductor_ID
    FROM conductor
    WHERE Name = 'Kyle'
),

-- Step 2: Find all Orchestra_IDs associated with Kyle
Kyle_Orchestras AS (
    SELECT Orchestra_ID
    FROM orchestra
    WHERE Conductor_ID = (SELECT Conductor_ID FROM Kyle_Conductor)
),

-- Step 3: Find all conductors who have worked with those orchestras
Kyle_Friends AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT C.Conductor_ID
    FROM conductor C
    JOIN orchestra O ON C.Conductor_ID = O.Conductor_ID
    WHERE O.Orchestra_ID IN (SELECT Orchestra_ID FROM Kyle_Orchestras)
      AND C.Name != 'Kyle' -- Exclude Kyle from the result
)

-- Step 4: Count the number of friends
SELECT COUNT(*) AS Number_of_Friends
FROM Kyle_Friends

INNER JOIN hiring ON employee.Employee_ID = hiring.Employee_ID
INNER JOIN shop ON hiring.Shop_ID = shop.Shop_ID
INNER JOIN evaluation ON employee.Employee_ID = evaluation.Employee_ID
WHERE evaluation.Bonus > 1000

-- Next, we join Students with Student_Enrolment_Courses to get students who take music courses
Music_Students AS (
    SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(sc.course_id) AS music_courses
    FROM Students s
    JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses sc ON s.student_id = (SELECT student_id FROM Student_Enrolment WHERE student_enrolment_id = sc.student_enrolment_id)
    JOIN Music_Courses mc ON sc.course_id = mc.course_id
    GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
)

WITH SingerStudents AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.student_id
    FROM Students s
    INNER JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses sec ON s.student_id = sec.student_enrolment_id
    INNER JOIN Courses c ON sec.course_id = c.course_id
    INNER JOIN Degree_Programs dp ON c.course_id = dp.degree_program_id
    INNER JOIN Departments d ON dp.department_id = d.department_id
    WHERE d.department_name = 'Music'
),
NationalityCounts AS (
    SELECT a.country AS nationality, COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM SingerStudents ss
    INNER JOIN Addresses a ON ss.student_id = a.address_id
    GROUP BY a.country
),
RankedNationalities AS (
    SELECT nationality, count,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY count DESC) AS rank
    FROM NationalityCounts
)
SELECT nationality
FROM RankedNationalities
WHERE rank = 1
